name: Project Dreamscape
detailed_description:
Every night when you close your eyes, you enter a mystical world of your own creation. But tonight is different. Your stress, struggles, and strain has all manifested itself into Dreamons - inner fiends that threaten to turn your slumber into a nightmare. 

Armed with a mystical shape-shifting hammer and guided by your childhood stuffed animal, you must fight to preserve your dream and confront what lies beneath.

Build your dreamscape one land at a time and unlock powerful abilities to face increasingly challenging waves of dreamons. Will you wake up refreshed, or forever trapped in your inner turmoil?

Features:

  • Chain combos together with a shapeshifting hammer, keep the combat chains going to increase your power, speed, and rewards.

  • Earn powerful Aspects that grant new combos and abilities that shake up each dream

  • Select and place new lands to expand your interconnected dreamscape. Each land sticks for the entirety of your dream, so place them wisely

  • Battle through the mystical Forest Land, volatile Fire Land, and delectable Food Land, each with unique hazards and enemies

  • Conquer diverse wave types that each require unique strategies to overcome

  • Overcome your inner demons and battle your dreamons for as long as possible. Will morning ever come?

Wield a shape-shifting hammer in fast-paced combat, battling waves of Dreamons. Unlock powerful Aspects, gain new abilities, and forge an ever-growing dreamworld in this vibrant adventure.
